intent: One new source-frozen clean Image reproduction to close the prior cached-object provenance gap; not a historical build receipt or ordinary adapter/performance experiment

freeze.record: Exact base tar and its hash; binary diff; full copied overlay/hash; all frozen source file hashes/symlink targets and executable modes; original critical hashes/status/HEAD before and after

old_metadata_read_directly.out/linux/include/generated/compile.h:
#define UTS_MACHINE		"riscv64"
#define LINUX_COMPILE_BY	"xvhaocheng"
#define LINUX_COMPILE_HOST	"xvhaocheng-dell"
#define LINUX_COMPILER		"riscv64-linux-gnu-gcc (Ubuntu 11.4.0-1ubuntu1~22.04) 11.4.0, GNU ld (GNU Binutils for Ubuntu) 2.38"

config_rule: Copy the already proven embedded config bytes unchanged into new O/.config. Leave CONFIG_INITRAMFS_SOURCE at original absolute path for exact reproduction; original file hash is checked before/after, and an independent exact copy is retained. Syncconfig from the Image build may regenerate only new O configuration, which will be compared exactly.
path_rule: Use the default Kbuild -fmacro-prefix-map=new_source/=, analogous to the old -fmacro-prefix-map=old_source/=. No extra KCFLAGS initially; record the actual new commands and mappings. Archive carries no .git; explicit full LOCALVERSION reproduces the old release label, but equality of bytes is the acceptance test.

acceptance.priority: Full new Image byte equality and SHA256 equality against old Image, with preserved exact original inputs and source freeze
stronger_checks: ELF SHA/section bytes/build ID and notes compared
Critical object byte/section comparison if Image differs
acceptance.stop: If Image differs, perform one bounded static difference analysis of Image/ELF sections and critical objects to distinguish metadata/path/code. Do not iterate unknown changes or rebuild to search for matching hashes. Do not claim source proof from a matching banner.
acceptance.build_limit: One clean make -j12 Image; at most one targeted recovery if a concrete build failure justifies it, retaining the original error. No adapter, no firmware, no ordinary runtime build or run in this task.
